subtopic_title: Addition and subtraction of positive and negative integers

candidate_atomic_objectives.proposed_objective_text: Write subtraction of integers as addition of opposite integers.
candidate_atomic_objectives.evidence_quote: Subtracting a number is the same as adding the "opposite" of the number.
candidate_atomic_objectives.rationale: The textbook teaches and assesses a symbolic rewrite rule for subtraction of integers. That is a distinct objective from solving subtraction on a number line, even though it supports the same broader topic.
